lanes.label: Version 2 · real-world setting
lanes.stem: A seasonal pricing report for a regional transit agency shows that after a fare increase of 12%, weekday passenger volume dropped by 18%. The agency's total operating fleet size remained constant at 250 buses. What is the absolute value of the price elasticity of demand for transit rides based on this data?

lanes.label: Version 3 · what-if
lanes.stem: A firm initially calculates the price elasticity of demand (in absolute value) for a good to be 2.0. If the percentage change in quantity demanded remains the same, but the percentage change in price that triggered it is doubled, what is the new absolute value of the price elasticity of demand?
